name: Mega Diancie ex Starter Set MEGA

releases.name: Mega Diancie ex Starter Set MEGA

description.text: Starter Set MEGA Mega Diancie ex, released on 5 September 2025 with Mega Gengar ex's, the first ready-built decks of Mega Evolution Pokémon ex: a ready-to-play 60-card deck with two Mega Diancie ex, a Basic Pokémon. Its Diamond Coat cuts the damage it takes by 30, and its Garland Ray discards up to two Energy from it for 120 damage each. Alcremie, Meloetta, which heals 120 damage from a Benched Psychic Pokémon, and the new Wondrous Patch, which attaches a basic Psychic Energy from the discard pile to one, back it up, with the ACE SPEC Hero's Cape, which lifts Mega Diancie ex to 370 HP. A full-illustration Meloetta sits among bright flowers in gentle sunshine. Damage counters and markers, a coin, a playmat, a player's guide and a how-to-play booklet came with it.
